retentionCandidates.candidate: Separately bounded retentionEndAt and lawful archival purpose; never inherit a temporary grant expiry or assume perpetual retention.

retentionCandidates.candidate: Minimal access/version/audit references only; separate explicit retentionEndAt, access role and minimization policy; do not retain full financial payload merely as audit.
retentionCandidates.specificDecisionNeeded: Approve audit schema, retention term and accountable custodian.

continuityPolicyClarification.revocation: Immediately deny live access/new saves using revoked/expired authority; revocation alone does not authorize deletion of delivery/audit records.

deletionCandidates.normal: On expiry deny ordinary reopen. Only a separately approved deletion executor may purge the defined record classes and references after a hold check; produce minimal audit proof.
deletionCandidates.hold: If a documented lawful hold exists, restrict access to a separately authorized custodian, set a mandatory reviewAt and defined exit condition; no invisible indefinite hold.
deletionCandidates.unresolved: If retention/hold/deletion authority is unknown, block production storage rather than collecting data without an executable lifecycle.

recovery.required: Audit recovery of orphaned reference/object pairs, missing/corrupt object, unavailable/rotated key and partial write; no synthetic COMPLETE or silent overwrite.
